basic_information.short_title: Creation of the Municipality of Datu Sinsuat Balabaran
basic_information.official_title: AN ACT CREATING THE MUNICIPALITY OF DATU SINSUAT BALABARAN IN THE PROVINCE OF MAGUINDANAO DEL NORTE, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after publication in the Bangsamoro Gazette or one newspaper of regional circulation

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Carves 13 barangays out of Datu Odin Sinsuat to create a new municipality, Datu Sinsuat Balabaran, in Maguindanao del Norte — subject to a plebiscite.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: The Organic Law empowers the Bangsamoro Government to create, divide, merge or abolish municipalities by act of Parliament, provided the change is ratified by the people directly affected.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: If ratified, 13 barangays covering about 144 square kilometres become a distinct and independent municipality seated at Barangay Tamontaka, with appointed first officials and ₱2.5 million monthly support until its tax share arrives.
who_will_be_affected: Residents of the 13 barangays, who vote in the plebiscite
Datu Odin Sinsuat, the mother municipality, which also loses 10 further barangays to Sheik Abas Hamza the same day
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: The act is in force, but corporate existence depends on ratification in a plebiscite. Section 5 was later amended by BAA 70.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: You decide. This creates the Municipality of Datu Sinsuat Balabaran from 13 barangays of Datu Odin Sinsuat — but only if voters approve it in a plebiscite.
in_practice: 13 barangays separate from Datu Odin Sinsuat: Tapian, Linek, Dinaig Proper, Tamontaka, Tanuel, Kusiong, Mompong, Semba, Capiton, Tambak, Badak, Awang and Dulangan
Land area of 143,984,505 square metres — about 144 square kilometres — with a technical description annexed to the act
The seat of government is Barangay Tamontaka, renamed the Poblacion
A plebiscite decides it, within 60 days of approval, run by COMELEC and paid from the BARMM Contingent Fund under the FY2024 budget
The Chief Minister appoints the first mayor, vice-mayor and eight Sangguniang Bayan members
₱2,500,000 a month until the municipality receives its Internal Revenue Allotment share

for_specific_groups.Voters in the 13 barangays: Your vote creates the municipality. Note that BAA 70 later amended the plebiscite provision to cover the political units directly affected.
for_specific_groups.Residents of Datu Odin Sinsuat: The mother municipality loses 13 barangays to this act and 10 more to BAA 55, both passed the same day.
for_specific_groups.Incumbent Sangguniang Bayan members of D: If you reside in the new municipality, you serve out your remaining term in the mother municipality.
for_specific_groups.Anyone concerned with boundaries: This act annexes a technical description of the boundary, which its two sibling acts do not.

what_this_means_for_you.where_this_applies: Maguindanao del Norte — 13 barangays currently in Datu Odin Sinsuat.
what_you_can_do: Check whether your barangay is among the 13 named in Section 2
Read BAA 70, which amended the plebiscite requirement in this act
watch_out_for: The first set of municipal officials is appointed by the Chief Minister, not elected.
Section 5 as originally enacted polled only the departing barangays; BAA 70 later widened it to the political units directly affected.
Financial assistance is a floor — 'not less than' ₱2.5 million monthly.

key_terms_explained.Plebiscite: A vote of the people directly affected, required before a municipality can be created.
key_terms_explained.Poblacion: The seat of government of a municipality — here, Barangay Tamontaka.
key_terms_explained.National Tax Allocation / IRA: A local government's share of national taxes.
key_terms_explained.Technical description: A surveyed statement of a boundary, annexed to this act.

what_this_means_for_you.status_note: Passed Jumada Al-Akhirah 07, 1445 / 20 December 2023, approved by the Chief Minister on 26 December 2023.

benefits.headline: A new municipality of 13 barangays and about 144 square kilometres, with ₱2.5 million a month until its tax share arrives.

direct_benefits.benefit: A local government seated in your own area
direct_benefits.how_to_access: Subject to ratification in the plebiscite

direct_benefits.amount: Not less than ₱2.5 million every month until the IRA share is allocated

direct_benefits.benefit: A surveyed boundary annexed to the act

indirect_benefits: Entitlement to a share of national taxes once allocated
limitations: Nothing takes effect without a favourable plebiscite.
The first officials are appointed, not elected.

for_citizens: None beyond voting in the plebiscite, which is a right rather than a duty.

what_is_prohibited: The act defines no prohibited acts and creates no offences.

penalties.for_citizens: None. The act creates no offence, fine or imprisonment.

where_to_complain.first_stop: Commission on Elections (COMELEC), which conducts and supervises the plebiscite
where_to_complain.oversight: Office of the Chief Minister, which appoints the first municipal officials
where_to_complain.note: The act creates no complaints procedure of its own.

everyday_scenarios: A resident of Barangay Kusiong votes in the plebiscite. If a majority of votes cast approve, Kusiong leaves Datu Odin Sinsuat for the new municipality.
A sitting councillor of Datu Odin Sinsuat living in Tamontaka finishes their term serving the mother municipality.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Policy: the Bangsamoro Government may create, divide, merge, abolish or substantially alter the boundaries of municipalities or barangays by act of Parliament, with units so created entitled to their share in national taxes or the National Tax Allocation, provided the change is approved by a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite in the political units directly affected.

Section 2 — Separates the barangays of Tapian, Linek, Dinaig Proper, Tamontaka, Tanuel, Kusiong, Mompong, Semba, Capiton, Tambak, Badak, Awang and Dulangan from the Municipality of Datu Odin Sinsuat and constitutes them into the distinct and independent Municipality of Datu Sinsuat Balabaran.
Section 3 — The seat of government is Barangay Tamontaka, known hereafter as the Poblacion.

Section 4 — The municipality contains a land area of 143,984,505 square metres. The territorial boundary follows the existing boundaries of the constituent barangays, and is bounded as described in the Technical Description attached as Annex 1b.

Section 5 — The municipality acquires corporate existence on ratification by a majority of the votes cast by qualified voters in a plebiscite in those barangays, held within 60 days after approval of the act. COMELEC conducts and supervises it, with the cost from the BARMM Contingent Fund under the FY2024 appropriations. (This section was subsequently amended by BAA 70.)

Section 6 — The municipal government comprises a mayor, a vice-mayor and eight Sangguniang Bayan members appointed by the Chief Minister immediately after ratification, holding office until successors are elected at the next regular election. Incumbent elective Sangguniang Bayan members of Datu Odin Sinsuat who actually reside in the new municipality serve out their remaining terms in the mother municipality.

Section 7 — The Bangsamoro Government shall appropriate financial assistance of not less than ₱2,500,000 every month for the administration and operation of the Municipal Government until it is allocated its share in the internal revenue allotment.

who_benefits: The new Municipal Government of Datu Sinsuat Balabaran
impact.allocated_budget: Not less than ₱2,500,000 per month until the IRA share is allocated; plebiscite costs from the BARMM Contingent Fund under FY2024.
impact.figures_note: Quoted from Sections 4, 5 and 7. Land area 143,984,505 square metres; no population figure is stated.

related_legislation.related_note: Passed the same day as BAA 53 (Nuling) and BAA 55 (Sheik Abas Hamza). Together with BAA 55 it takes 23 barangays from the same mother municipality, Datu Odin Sinsuat. Section 5 was later amended by BAA 70.

implementation_status.budget_appropriated: Not less than ₱2,500,000 monthly, pending IRA allocation
implementation_status.note: Read from the enacted text as signed. Section 5 was subsequently amended by BAA 70 — read that act for the plebiscite requirement as it now stands. The Technical Description annexed as Annex 1b is not reproduced in this registry.

citizen_questions.a: Thirteen, currently in Datu Odin Sinsuat: Tapian, Linek, Dinaig Proper, Tamontaka, Tanuel, Kusiong, Mompong, Semba, Capiton, Tambak, Badak, Awang and Dulangan.
143,984,505 square metres — roughly 144 square kilometres — with a surveyed technical description annexed to the act.
Not until a plebiscite ratifies it. Note that Section 5 was later amended by BAA 70, which widened the vote to the political units directly affected.

citizen_questions.q: Who will be the first mayor?
citizen_questions.a: Whoever the Chief Minister appoints. The first mayor, vice-mayor and eight councillors are appointed after ratification and serve until the next regular election.

citizen_questions.q: How will it pay for itself?
citizen_questions.a: Not less than ₱2.5 million a month from the Bangsamoro Government until it receives its share of the internal revenue allotment.
